topic: Acalypha persimilis versus Acalypha ostryifolia; formal conservation proposal (3080)

sources.citation: Applequist et al. (2026), Report of the Nomenclature Committee for Vascular Plants: 77, Taxon
sources.role: committee analysis and vote, item 3080, 2–16–2 not recommended as unnecessary

sources.citation: Kew Plants of the World Online, Acalypha persimilis

resolution: Committee's 2026 report concluded Riddell's 1835 original A. ostryifolia included sufficient description to validly publish the name, which would make that older name priority over A. persimilis; it recommended against conservation because unnecessary. This differs from Kew POWO's current A. persimilis-accepted classification.
identity_guardrail: Published taxon descriptions consider these names synonymous in prevailing treatment; do not create duplicate cards. Do not equate database acceptance with a binding IAPT decision or unilaterally rename species.json.
character_warning: Earlier published differences in pistillate bract number/length and style branching were judged variable or misconstrued in the 2025 proposal; don't create an absolute separation key for the two names.
remaining_action: Revisit only if a binding nomenclatural decision or authoritative taxonomic database update warrants canonical name change. This is not a prompt for another full audit.
preservation: Additive research only; photos, credits, gallery, species.json unchanged
